hooks.text: Dinosaurs walked on Earth before Saturn had its rings.
Saturn's iconic rings are younger than the dinosaurs.
Saturn went ringless for over four billion years.

title: Saturn's Rings Are Younger Than Dinosaurs
description: Cassini data revealed that Saturn's massive ring system is only 10 to 100 million years old, formed from a shredded icy moon.
